findingDetails.case: A host process launched without AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 dispatches an in-process subagent; that child's brief renders a startable mutating command instead of a parent-named marker.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n childSession across the skill, hooks and plugin returns the renderer only; skill-advisor-brief.ts exposes no such option and the plugin never passes it.
findingDetails.title: The child-session command downgrade is decided only by a process-wide env flag

findingDetails.case: A CLI that emits a long stream grows the parent heap without limit until the timeout kills it.
findingDetails.scopeProof: subprocess.ts defines no MAX_* constant; the fallback path in the same skill caps both streams at MAX_STDOUT_BYTES.
findingDetails.title: The low-level advisor spawn accumulates child output without a byte cap

findingDetails.case: A recommendation that attaches a mutating command while resolving a read-only skill row renders as runnable in a child.
findingDetails.scopeProof: render.ts:223-237 is the only label builder and reads row.mutating exactly once; all current producers pair a command with its own row.
findingDetails.title: The child downgrade reads mutability from the skill row, not from the command that is printed
